added_observations.notes: Reviewed 2026-11-16. Published 2026-11-13. Fieldwork 27 May to 6 July 2026; 50% CATI and 50% CAWI, weighted by age/gender and federal state. Question asks usual leisure frequency; daily or several times per week. Print excludes school reading. Formats overlap. The report combines audiobooks with radio plays, so this source contributes no audiobook observation. This youth reading frequency is not comparable with adult annual participation or daily population reach.
